fullPassage:
(A)
Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.

(D)
The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, "I think Leo has a minor infection." "Infection? Will he be okay?" asked Christine. "We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here," replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.

(B)
"I'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything," said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. "The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon." Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.

(C)
The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry (A), Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. (B) for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She (C) hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Leo는 Christine의 털복숭이 동반자(companion)이고, 그녀는 사랑하는 고양이를 걱정하여(concerned) 병원에 데려갔으며, 간절히(desperately) 필요한 치료를 받길 바랐다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① companion — concerned — desperately: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌ ② stranger: companion의 반의어
❌ ③ indifferent: concerned의 반의어
❌ ④ calmly: desperately의 반의어
❌ ⑤ 세 단어 모두 반의어
det.tip: companion(동반자)↔stranger(낯선이), concerned(걱정하는)↔indifferent(무관심한), desperately(간절히)↔calmly(차분히)

questions.passage: Throughout the day, Christine (A) awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. "The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon." (B) to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo (C) regained his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Christine은 초조하게(anxiously) 소식을 기다렸고, 좋은 소식에 안도하여(relieved) 병원으로 달려갔으며, Leo는 점차(gradually) 기력을 회복했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① anxiously — relieved — gradually: 원문 일치
❌ ② disappointed(실망한): 소식이 좋았으므로 relieved가 맞음
❌ ③ calmly(차분히): anxiously가 원문
❌ ④ suddenly(갑자기): gradually가 원문
❌ ⑤ 두 단어가 반의어
det.tip: anxiously(초조하게)↔calmly(차분히), relieved(안도한)↔disappointed(실망한), gradually(점차)↔suddenly(갑자기)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 수의사는 검사를 위해 Leo가 병원에 머물러야(stay) 한다고 했다. ④ leave(떠나다)는 stay의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ leave(떠나다): 원문은 stay(머물다) → 검사를 위해 병원에 남아야 한다는 문맥
✅ ① certain(확신하는): 원문 일치
✅ ② necessary(필요한): 원문 일치
✅ ③ gently(부드럽게): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ heartbreaking(마음 아픈): 원문 일치
det.tip: stay(머물다) ↔ leave(떠나다) — "for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here"가 원문

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 좋은 소식을 듣고 안도하여(Relieved) 병원으로 달려갔다. ② Devastated(충격을 받은)는 Relieved의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ② Devastated(충격을 받은): 원문은 Relieved(안도한) → 좋은 소식에 안도한 것

✅ ③ administer(투여하다): 원문 일치
✅ ④ comfortable(편안한): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ regained(회복했다): 원문 일치
det.tip: Relieved(안도한) ↔ Devastated(충격을 받은) — 좋은 소식 → 안도가 자연스러움

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry <u>companion</u>, Leo.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 companion의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: companion = 동반자, partner = 짝, 동반자 → 의미 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ③ partner(동반자): companion의 동의어
❌ ① enemy(적): 반의어
❌ ② acquaintance(지인): 더 먼 관계
❌ ④ rival(경쟁자): 다른 의미
det.tip: companion = partner = fellow = 동반자, 짝

questions.passage: Relieved to hear the news, Christine <u>rushed</u> back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 rushed의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: rushed = 서둘러 갔다, hurried = 서둘렀다 → 의미 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ② hurried(서둘렀다): rushed의 동의어
❌ ① refused(거절했다): 다른 의미
❌ ③ strolled(산책했다): 반의어(느리게 걸음)
❌ ④ hesitated(망설였다): 다른 의미
det.tip: rushed = hurried = dashed = 서둘러 갔다 ↔ strolled(느긋이 걸었다)

questions.passage: As the days passed, Leo gradually <u>regained</u> his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 regained의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: regained = 되찾았다, recovered = 회복했다 → 의미 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ④ recovered(회복했다): regained의 동의어
❌ ① lost(잃었다): 반의어
❌ ② maintained(유지했다): 다른 의미(잃은 적 없음)
❌ ③ diminished(줄었다): 반의어
det.tip: regained = recovered = got back = 되찾다, 회복하다 ↔ lost(잃다)

questions.passage: <u>Concerned</u> for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 Concerned의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: Concerned = 걱정하는 ↔ indifferent = 무관심한
det.analysis:
❌ ① indifferent(무관심한): Concerned의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ② anxious(불안한): 유사어
✅ ③ worried(걱정하는): 동의어
✅ ④ afraid(두려운): 유사어
det.tip: concerned = worried = anxious(걱정하는) ↔ indifferent = unconcerned(무관심한)

questions.passage: It was <u>heartbreaking</u> for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 heartbreaking의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: heartbreaking = 마음이 아픈 ↔ joyful = 기쁜
det.analysis:
❌ ② joyful(기쁜): heartbreaking의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① sorrowful(슬픈): 유사어
✅ ③ painful(고통스러운): 유사어
✅ ④ distressing(괴로운): 유사어
det.tip: heartbreaking = sorrowful = distressing(가슴 아픈) ↔ joyful = delightful(기쁜)

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was __________ that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Christine은 항상 이 병원에 Leo를 데려갔기 때문에 수의사가 Leo에 대해 잘 안다고 확신했다(certain).
det.analysis:
✅ ② certain(확신하는): "always brought Leo to this hospital"이 근거 → 확신
❌ ① doubted(의심했다): 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ confused(혼란스러운): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ unaware(모르는): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: certain = sure = confident = 확신하는 — "always"가 확신의 근거

questions.passage: The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently __________ him. The vet said, "I think Leo has a minor infection."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수의사가 Leo를 부드럽게 진찰했다(examined).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ examined(진찰했다): 수의사가 환자를 진찰하는 문맥에 적합
❌ ① ignored(무시했다): 문맥과 반대
❌ ② abandoned(버렸다): 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ avoided(피했다): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: examined = inspected = checked = 진찰하다, 검사하다

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to __________ the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수의사가 약을 투여하는(administer) 방법에 대해 상세한 지시를 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ administer(투여하다): "how to administer the medication" → 약 투여 방법
❌ ① prescribe(처방하다): 의사가 처방하는 것이지 보호자가 하는 행위가 아님
❌ ② diagnose(진단하다): 약 관련 아님
❌ ③ inject(주사하다): 약 투여의 일부이나 원문은 administer
det.tip: administer medication = 약을 투여하다 — 의료 맥락에서 자주 사용되는 표현

questions.passage: The vet said, "I think Leo has a <u>minor</u> infection."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 minor의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: minor infection = 가벼운 감염
det.analysis:
✅ ① 사소한, 가벼운: minor + 질병/감염 = 가벼운 감염
❌ ② 미성년자의: minor(미성년자)
❌ ③ 단조의: minor key(단조)
❌ ④ 부전공의: minor in(부전공하다)
det.tip: minor: 사소한/가벼운(가장 흔한) | 미성년자(법률) | 단조(음악) | 부전공(학업)

questions.passage: Leo needs some medication and <u>rest</u>, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 rest의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: medication and rest = 약과 휴식
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 안정, 휴식: medication and rest → 명사로 "휴식"
❌ ① 휴식하다: 동사 의미 → 여기서는 명사
❌ ② 나머지: the rest of → 다른 의미
❌ ④ 받침대: arm rest → 다른 의미
det.tip: rest: 휴식(명사/동사) | 나머지(the rest of) | 받침대(armrest)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"to give or apply a drug, medicine, or treatment to someone"

det.korean: '누군가에게 약, 의약품 또는 치료를 주거나 적용하다' → administer(투여하다)
det.analysis:
✅ ② administer: 영영 정의와 정확히 일치
❌ ① examine: 진찰하다
❌ ③ prescribe: 처방하다 (약을 정해주는 것)
❌ ④ diagnose: 진단하다
det.tip: administer = give/apply medication → 약을 투여하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"causing overwhelming grief or sadness"

det.korean: '압도적인 슬픔이나 비탄을 일으키는' → heartbreaking(가슴 아픈)
det.analysis:
✅ ① heartbreaking: 영영 정의와 일치
❌ ② exciting: 흥미진진한
❌ ③ boring: 지루한
❌ ④ amusing: 재미있는
det.tip: heartbreaking = causing grief/sadness = 가슴 아픈, 비통한

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a __________ (comfort) space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: comfort(명사/동사) → comfortable(형용사): space를 수식하는 형용사 필요
det.analysis:
comfort(명사/동사) → comfortable(형용사)
"a comfortable space" — 명사 space 앞에서 수식하는 형용사가 필요
det.tip: comfort → comfortable(형용사) → comfortably(부사) — 명사 수식 = 형용사

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy __________ (recover). Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: recover(동사) → recovery(명사): "a speedy ____" 구조에서 형용사 speedy 뒤에 명사 필요
det.analysis:
recover(동사) → recovery(명사)
"a speedy recovery" — 관사 a + 형용사 speedy 뒤에 명사가 와야 함
det.tip: recover → recovery / discover → discovery — -er → -ery 명사화 패턴

questions.passage: The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, "I think Leo has a minor infection." "Infection? Will he be okay?" asked Christine. "We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here," replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to __________ it was for the best.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마음은 아팠지만 Leo를 위해 최선이라는 것을 받아들여야(accept) 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② accept(받아들이다): "heartbreaking ... but she had to accept" → 힘들지만 수용
❌ ① reject(거부하다): 문맥과 반대 — but 뒤이므로 수용의 의미
❌ ③ deny(부인하다): 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ ignore(무시하다): 문맥과 무관
❌ ⑤ celebrate(축하하다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: heartbreaking but accept: 마음은 아프지만 받아들이다 — but이 역접을 나타냄

questions.stem: 윗글에 관한 내용으로 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 본문: "Later that day" → 같은 날에 전화를 받았다. "다음 날"이 아니므로 ②는 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ② 병원 방문한 다음 날 수의사의 전화: 원문은 "Later that day" → 같은 날
✅ ① "she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo" → 일치
✅ ③ "shared tips for a speedy recovery" → 일치
✅ ④ "The waiting room was filled with other pet owners" → 일치
✅ ⑤ "We need to do some tests to see if he is infected" → 일치
det.tip: "Later that day" = 그날 나중에 (같은 날) ≠ "다음 날" — 시간 표현 정확히 구분하기

ch: Christine은 수의사가 Leo에 대해 잘 알고 있을 거라고 확신했다.
Christine은 병원을 방문한 다음 날 수의사의 전화를 받았다.
수의사는 Leo의 빠른 회복을 위한 조언을 했다.
대기실은 다른 반려동물의 주인들로 꽉 차 있었다.
Leo의 감염 여부를 알기 위해 검사를 할 필요가 있었다.
